title: [BugFix][MRV2] Share KV cache backing for Step-3.5/3.7
body:
### What this PR does / why we need it?
This PR is a **Model Runner V2 follow-up to #18316**.

#18316 enabled shared KV cache backing and matching budget handling for Step-3.5/3.7 on the V1 allocation path. MRV2 still allocated the same shared cache pool once per descriptor, which could cause **KV cache initialization OOM**.

This PR ports the missing allocation fix to MRV2. For `step3p5` / `step3p7`, it:

- validates the shared-backing layout;
- allocates one common backing tensor;
- exposes each layer as a bounded contiguous view into that backing.

This PR **does not replace or revert #18316**. It preserves the existing V1 behavior and applies the corresponding V2 fix; other models remain unchanged.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?
No.
### How was this patch tested?

CI test.

---
### Checklist

#### Testing

- [x] **Boundary / edge-case coverage**: I reviewed whether this change involves
  boundary conditions (e.g. empty input, single/zero element, min/max values,
  off-by-one, sequence-length limits, integer overflow). Where applicable, I
  added unit tests covering these edge cases in `tests/ut/` or `tests/e2e/`.
- [x] **Regression test**: If this PR fixes a bug, I added a regression test
  that would fail without the fix.
- [x] **Error / failure path coverage**: I covered abnormal paths (exceptions,
  timeouts, out-of-range, division by zero) in addition to the happy path.
- [x] **Meaningful & reliable tests**: New tests assert real behavior and are
  not written merely to satisfy CI.
- [x] **Performance impact**: I attached performance regression tests; at peak concurrency 64 with 48% actual KV-cache utilization, TTFT averaged 13.61 s, TPOT averaged 52.60 ms, and output throughput reached 1,141.76 tokens/s in aggregate.
